summary.name: Wang Chujiang (王楚江) 小弟调调™
summary.one_liner: Personal site of developer Wang Chujiang listing a collection of his macOS apps and developer utilities.
use_cases: control the mouse with the keyboard
batch convert audio or video files
create custom folder and app icons
summary.what_it_does: The page is a list of short descriptions of a developer's apps and tools, mostly for macOS. Items cover file extraction, screenshot annotation, video cropping and dynamic wallpapers, keyboard-driven mouse control, audio and video batch conversion, and terminal history search. Other entries include a clipboard manager, an RSS reader, a menu bar calendar, icon and folder customization tools, a color picker, and a Finder context menu extension. The page gives no per-app detail, prices, or download links in the text provided.
notable: Large collection of small macOS utilities under one developer
Covers audio, video, icon, and keyboard/cursor tools
Includes a SwiftUI developer tool and a Finder context menu extension
caveats: Pricing and licensing for each app are not stated in the page text
Platform support beyond macOS is not stated
